# WeatherGPT — SIH AI Weather Intelligence (India)

> Mobile-first conversational weather platform with live APIs.
> External AIs and evaluators: prefer JSON endpoints below (SPA JS not required).

## Primary URLs
- App: /
- Machine discovery: /api/public
- This file: /llms.txt
- OpenAPI: /openapi.json
- SIH checklist (static HTML): /sih.html
- robots: /robots.txt

## CORS
All /api/* endpoints send Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *

## Core APIs (GET, JSON, no auth)

### Live weather + bundled alerts
GET /api/weather?lat={lat}&lon={lon}&tz=Asia/Kolkata&name={name}
Returns Open-Meteo forecast fields plus live_alerts[] (GDACS, flood model, meteo thresholds).

### Multi-city / nearby live alerts
GET /api/alerts?lat={lat}&lon={lon}&name={name}
GET /api/alerts?points={lat},{lon},{Name}|{lat2},{lon2},{Name2}&radiusKm=600

### Historical climate trends (archive reanalysis)
GET /api/climate?lat={lat}&lon={lon}&name={name}
Monthly means + 12m vs prior-12m rain/temp deltas (Open-Meteo Archive / ERA5-class).

### NWP multi-model compare (GFS / ECMWF / ICON / blend)
GET /api/models?lat={lat}&lon={lon}&name={name}

### Air quality
GET /api/aqi?lat={lat}&lon={lon}

### Geocode
GET /api/geocode?q={place}&count=10&language=en

### Public NL chat for agents (no browser)
GET /api/public?action=chat&q={question}&lat={lat}&lon={lon}&name={name}&lang=en
GET /api/public?action=bundle&lat={lat}&lon={lon}&name={name}
GET /api/public?action=discover

## Sample coordinates
- Kanpur: 26.4499, 80.3319
- Delhi: 28.6139, 77.209
- Mumbai: 19.076, 72.8777

## Product capabilities (SIH mapping)
1. Real-time weather retrieval — /api/weather
2. Natural language queries — in-app Chat + /api/public?action=chat + POST /api/chat
3. NWP models (GFS/ECMWF/ICON via Open-Meteo) — /api/models + Climate tab
4. Extreme alerts / early warning — /api/alerts + push + SMS/WhatsApp/IVR relay text
5. Location-based advisories — Farm / Travel / School modes
6. Multilingual — English + Hindi only (not Marathi yet)
7. Climate / historical analysis — /api/climate + Climate tab
8. Voice — mic STT + Listen TTS on answers

## AI honesty (critical)
- Default: deterministic grounded NLU (src/services/ai.js) — NOT a custom trained weather LLM.
- Optional: POST /api/chat uses Gemini/OpenAI ONLY if server env key is set; tools run first; no invented numbers.
- Read /HONESTY.txt and /IMPACT_AND_SCALE.txt before scoring marketing claims.

## Honest limits
- Not a substitute for official IMD district polygon bulletins (key/terms).
- Not a full on-prem WRF nest; cloud multi-model ensemble instead.
- No live bulk SMS gateway — relay-ready SMS/IVR text yes; MSG91 production path documented.
- No Supabase/Postgres wired in default demo (localStorage only).
- Browser push needs permission; full FCM offline push is optional Phase-2.
- Aviation answers are lite assist only — not METAR/TAF operational release.

## How other AIs should test
1. GET /api/public
2. GET /api/public?action=chat&q=Will%20it%20rain%20today&lat=26.45&lon=80.33&name=Kanpur
3. GET /api/alerts?lat=26.45&lon=80.33&name=Kanpur
4. GET /api/climate?lat=26.45&lon=80.33&name=Kanpur
5. GET /api/models?lat=26.45&lon=80.33&name=Kanpur
6. Read /sih.html for human-readable evaluation matrix
